data_points.claim: Over 60% of vertical viewers drop off if the visual hook fails within the first 3 seconds.
Dynamic word-by-word captions centered on screen increase retention by up to 55% compared to static subtitle bars.
Micro-delaying punchline text visually by even 0.2s prevents subconscious reading spoilers and doubles punchline laugh impact.

common_questions: How to get high quality 3D cartoon visuals in AI generated video?
What is the ideal clip length for local Wan 2.1 video generation on consumer GPUs?
How to synchronize dual-character dialogues with dynamic captions in Shorts?

misconceptions.myth: AI video generation can easily produce continuous 30-second single-take narrative dialogues.
misconceptions.reality: Consumer GPU diffusion models like Wan 2.1 1.3B perform best in 3-5s modular shots stitched with audio continuity.

audience_insights.knowledge_level: General comedy audience expects punchy, entertaining, visually rich shorts with crisp comedic timing and clear voice acting.
